LOCAL BUILT-IN WUBI ENTRIES (2026-10-12, app 0.1.8)

Source: the user's explicit request to add these eight pairs to the built-in
dictionary. These are locally maintained plain data, not downloaded upstream
data, a user dictionary export, learned input, or inferred Wubi encodings.

Requested pairs, preserved exactly:
  微信 tmwy
  安卓 pvhj
  北川 uxkt
  美团 uglt
  抖音 ruuj
  支付宝 fwpg
  滴滴 iuiu

Maintained source: wubi86_high_priority.dict.yaml
Manifest role: supplement, exact_priority=true; all eight rows have effective weight zero.
Merge/tie order: unchanged Rime baseline, high-priority source, IT,
administrative divisions, general words, historic/cultural cities, then idioms.
Static weight remains the primary ordinary sort key. Deduplicate exact
(text, code) pairs only, first occurrence wins;
preserve alternate codes and other words. All eight requested exact pairs were
absent from the preceding six-source build, so all eight are newly retained.

Priority: the offline builder reads every row in the marked source and puts
its existing matching word first in that complete-code group. Multiple words
for the same code retain source/file order, with exact pair deduplication.
Other exact candidates retain the order produced by current static weights
and the source order above. Partial-prefix selection uses those same weights
and the new tie order; it can differ from prior releases. Full-code promotion
itself does not reweight prefixes.
No separately hardcoded eight-word runtime mapping is used.

Runtime: compiled into the read-only compact-wubi.skwb asset. These rows use
the existing Wubi query path and do not depend on mutable user content; clearing
either user dictionary or all user content does not remove the built-in data.
No networking, learning, input-history recording, or new runtime storage is added.

This local-source notice does not relicense the baseline or upstream supplements.
The original upstream licensing notices and private-testing restriction remain.
